title: What Timeshare Can Teach Hospitality About Experience-Led Loyalty: Watch Video
description: Vacation ownership companies have an advantage in experiential loyalty: They already know their customers over years, not days. At Skift Global Forum, ARDA and Hilton Grand Vacations explained why access, relevance, and owner feedback matter more than simply adding more things to do.

why_it_matters_de: Die Einsichten aus dem Timesharing-Sektor könnten Hotels helfen, bessere Loyalitätsprogramme zu entwickeln und den Zugang sowie die Relevanz für ihre Gäste zu verbessern. Erfahrung und Feedback sind Schlüsselthemen, die für die langfristige Kundenbindung entscheidend sind.

title: Klook Withdraws U.S. IPO, Citing Market Conditions
description: Klook may have pulled its IPO, but the pitch hasn’t changed. Experiences are still one of the least digitized parts of travel, and that’s a lot of runway. The catch? Viator, GetYourGuide and the OTAs know it too, and Klook needs to move fast before they close the gap.

why_it_matters_de: Die Rücknahme des IPOs könnte Klook dazu zwingen, schneller in der digitalen Transformation von Erlebnissen zu agieren, was Auswirkungen auf die Wettbewerbslandschaft im Tourismus hat.

title: UK’s India Growth Plan Means Getting Travelers Out of London

Folding a protein target, screening a 50,000 compound ligand library, or evaluating structure-activity relationships (SAR) are not quick API lookups. summary_de: Google kündigt das Wiz Runtime Sensor-Add-On für Google Kubernetes Engine an, das Echtzeitschutz vor Bedrohungen bietet.
